queries_run: MACOM MTSI silicon photonics CPO threat to optical analog drivers TIAs 2026
MACOM Technology Solutions technology obsolescence risk GaN silicon alternative 2026

findings.claim: 公司 FY2025 10-K 自述：預期未來會有採用替代技術的公司（含使用低成本矽製程的大量製造商）帶來更多競爭。
findings.excerpt: We believe that in the future there will be increased competition from companies utilizing alternative technologies, including high-volume manufacturers using low-cost silicon process technology.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：未來競爭可能來自新替代技術、更高整合度的 IC 廠商，且客戶與供應商可能自行開發競品或取代本公司產品。
findings.excerpt: We believe future competition could also come from companies developing new alternative technologies, component suppliers based in countries with lower production costs and IC manufacturers achieving higher levels of integration that exceed the functionality offered by our products. Our customers and suppliers could also develop products that compete with or replace our products.

findings.claim: 搜尋摘要：有評論文章指出，若超大規模業者透過矽光子/CPO 把光學子系統內製，MACOM 的離散光電二極體、TIA、DFB 雷射市場可能縮小；該風險在財報會議未被量化，且未找到 CPO 已減少其 TIA/驅動器出貨量的硬數據。CPO 大量部署預估 2027-2028。
findings.source: WebSearch 摘要（聚合多來源，其中看空論述為意見文章）

findings.claim: 搜尋摘要：MACOM 448G 驅動器採高量產矽製程，支援矽光子、EML、TFLN 多平台；公司稱新品針對 CPO/NPO 架構最佳化。
findings.source: ConvergeDigest／Barchart 報導 448G PAM4 驅動器（經搜尋摘要）

substitute_technology.note: 第3、4條為搜尋摘要綜述，無逐字原文；日期為推估。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條
